messages.label: Phase 1 (listening_for_discover) progress trigger — advances to listening_for_request. Cond: is_dhcp_discover() and chaddr_matches_dut_mac(expected.dut_iface_mac)
Phase 2 (listening_for_request) pass trigger — transitions to pass. Cond: is_dhcp_request() and chaddr_matches_dut_mac(expected.dut_iface_mac) and (dst_ip_is_broadcast())
